# M0-S5: with no logos.toml, an explicit CGO_ENABLED=1 in the
# environment wins over the absent-key default and the build proceeds.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Default CC: a host compiler setting must not drive the build.
env CC=

[cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[cgo] logos build .
[cgo] logos run .
[cgo] stdout '^env: 42$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/cgoenv

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("env:", C.answer()) }
